title: Implement and link the native E1S PCIe/SysMMU/MSI Wi-Fi backend
acceptance: Concrete E1S power/PHY/PCIe/reset, SysMMU/cache and MSI primitives compile and link with the pinned XNU; no success-returning hardware stubs
Rebuild the exact selected Ath12kWifi runtime and board against one reviewed ABI/dependency pin, with component/file license review
Firmware/board/regulatory loading uses explicitly supplied matching local inputs; no sheng firmware, addresses, no-op cache sync or userdata layout inherited blindly
Keep actual endpoint, DMA reachability, IRQ delivery, calibration and hardware lifecycle qualification in NET-002/003
steps: Implement real kernel callbacks and bounded worker teardown
Build/link and retain negative-path evidence before separately scoped native execution
